Name: Dodo, Father of Puah
Summary: Dodo is named in Tola's lineage, as the father of Puah.
KeyStory: Dodo appears in Judges only in Tola's genealogy: Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo.
RelatedPeople: Puah, Father of Tola; Tola, Son of Puah
LifeLesson: A grandfather's name, kept alive in a grandson's introduction.
